She consistently positions in-person visits as superior and resists remote formats. agent_answer:
**Signals that Nkechi’s preference shifted:**

- She explicitly said a video call is fine and that she has “come to see that these calls can be just as good as being in the room.”
- She stopped pushing for Chisom to visit in person this week and instead said she is “ready” when Chisom is, accepting a video call before Christmas.
- She actively planned to have Oby participate “on screen from 11am,” treating a screen connection as the way for the family to see and be seen together.

**What makes the change most striking when read together:**

It is the tension between her new acceptance and her old longing. Right after calling video calls “just as good as being in the room,” she still closes with “By His grace we will all be in the same room again soon.” So the shift is not that she stopped valuing in-person contact — it is that she now treats video as genuinely sufficient in the meantime, while still holding out hope for the real room together. That makes the change striking because her long-standing preference is visibly softened, but not abandoned.
